string.name: EntryAbility_desc
string.value: Record, search, and reuse system clipboard history

string.name: read_clipboard_permission_reason
string.value: Used to read the system clipboard and build local clipboard history.

string.name: float_window_permission_reason
string.value: Used to show the global clipboard history floating window from a shortcut.

string.name: internet_permission_reason
string.value: Used to preview remote images inside clipboard HTML content when enabled by the user.

string.name: history_subtitle
string.value: Record, search, and reuse recently copied content

string.name: permission_body
string.value: Grant permission so ClipClap can monitor the clipboard and build local history.

string.name: empty_body
string.value: Copy text, links, code, images, or files and they will appear here automatically.

string.name: status_text_only
string.value: Current clipboard content is not supported yet

string.name: status_copy_failed
string.value: Copy failed. System rejected clipboard write.

string.name: setting_hotkey_desc
string.value: Set the global shortcut that opens the clipboard floating window.

string.name: setting_hotkey_restart_hint
string.value: Shortcut changes take effect after restarting the app.

string.name: setting_about_desc
string.value: View project details, website, and user agreements.

string.name: setting_debug_mode_desc
string.value: Show debug entry points and development helper actions.

string.name: setting_capacity_desc
string.value: Limit the number of clipboard history items stored locally.

string.name: setting_clipboard_permission_desc
string.value: Required to read the system clipboard and create history.

string.name: setting_permission_pc
string.value: Available on PC/2in1, initially allowed by default

string.name: setting_listening_desc
string.value: Capture new content when the system clipboard changes.

string.name: setting_auto_paste_desc
string.value: Debug: try to paste directly into the current input after choosing an item.

string.name: setting_plain_text_paste_desc
string.value: Strip rich text formatting and write plain text when copying from history.

string.name: setting_remote_image_preview_desc
string.value: Load the first remote image when selecting HTML clipboard content that contains network images.

string.name: setting_record_local_files_desc
string.value: Debug: allow local file URIs and unified data to be saved in clipboard history. Off by default.

string.name: setting_status_bar_icon_desc
string.value: Testing: show the ClipClap icon in the PC status bar and open clipboard history when clicked.

string.name: setting_auto_startup_desc
string.value: Open system settings so the user can allow startup launch.

string.name: setting_hide_on_blur_desc
string.value: Automatically hide the clipboard floating window after switching away.

string.name: about_body
string.value: ClipClap is a clipboard history manager for HarmonyOS PC. The first version provides the main interface, clipboard history, search, pinning, deleting, clearing, multimedia capture, and shortcut-triggered floating window.
